description: Per-platform performance baselines. Rolling medians rather than absolute targets, so 'underperforming' means underperforming relative to this account's own history rather than an industry number we cannot verify.

learning_thresholds.note: The spec's 14-day underperformance rule fires only once the platform has at least min_instances_for_median published items to form a baseline from. Before that there is no median to compare against.
